dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge characterized by a deep, irregular V-shaped notch at mid-height, with a concave pixel boundary below and a recurved convex spline leading to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small posterior-leaning hook; shape is obtuse with a pixel radius of approximately 15 pixels at the tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Continuous convex curvature with an average slope of 42 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 2.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible trauma in the form of a prominent jagged notch on the trailing edge; high-density distribution of white punctate scars and depigmented circular marks across the lateral surface of the fin and dorsal back.
other_distinctive_markers: Elongated, shallow-sloping dorsal ridge preceding the anterior insertion of the dorsal fin.
